**Correction** — duplicate modes and pairing RX wavelengths with every bit rate are not supported by the datasheet. One product, one protocol list, one bit-rate range; TX **1520–1580 nm** and RX **1260–1600 nm** are different parameters on the same module, not separate selectable modes.

```json

  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "SO-SFP-10G-ZR100 multirate 0.6–11.3Gbps ZR 100km",

```

The schema allows only one `bit_rate_gbps` per mode; **0.6** and **11.3** are the endpoints of a single **0.6–11.3 Gbps** row in Technical Data / ordering—not two modes. **1260** / **1600** belong to the receiver wavelength row for the same SKU; they are not a second host application mode. If your pipeline requires every pooled atom to appear, say how you want range endpoints and RX-only wavelengths represented (e.g. optional fields or a single mode with arrays).
